outlets.name: Falstaff
outlets.credible: Leading German/Austrian food-and-wine magazine with restaurant, winery and community ratings; German-language editorial authority used here to measure and corroborate (Kalinski, Henry's, Quack, Petgen-Dahm).

outlets.name: regio-saarland.com
outlets.credible: German-language Saarland regional magazine/portal with editorial food and travel round-ups (ice-cream cafés, Italian restaurants, Veganuary guides); corroborating local source, not a rating aggregator.

outlets.name: Saarbrücken Guide
outlets.credible: German-language independent Saarbrücken city guide with a curated insider restaurant/sights list written like a local; editorial (not user-rating) content.

outlets.name: Saarpfalz-Touristik / Biosphäre Bliesgau
outlets.credible: Official tourism authority for the Saarpfalz-Kreis and the UNESCO Bliesgau Biosphere Reserve (Blieskastel, Homburg, Bexbach); German-language.

outlets.name: Kreis- und Universitätsstadt Homburg
outlets.credible: Official city of Homburg tourism pages (Schlossberghöhlen); German-language municipal source.

outlets.name: Kreisstadt Merzig
outlets.credible: Official city of Merzig tourism pages (Wolfspark Werner Freund); German-language municipal source.

outlets.name: Kreisstadt Neunkirchen
outlets.credible: Official city of Neunkirchen pages (Neunkircher Zoo); German-language municipal source.

outlets.name: Gemeinde Ensdorf
outlets.credible: Official municipality of Ensdorf pages (Bergehalde & Saarpolygon); German-language municipal source.

outlets.name: Stadt Ottweiler
outlets.credible: Official city of Ottweiler tourism/heritage pages (historic old town); German-language municipal source.

outlets.name: Region Neunkirchen Tourismus
outlets.credible: Regional tourism site for the Neunkirchen area; German-language.

outlets.name: regionalgeschichte.net
outlets.credible: Scholarly regional-history portal of the Institut für Geschichtliche Landeskunde (Mainz); authoritative German-language source on Saar monuments (Basilika St. Johann, Alte Brücke).

outlets.name: Saarland.de (Staatskanzlei)
outlets.credible: Official Saarland state government pages (Ludwigsplatz ensemble history); German-language.

outlets.name: Stiftung Saarländischer Kulturbesitz
outlets.credible: State cultural-heritage foundation running the Saarlandmuseum and Roman Villa Nennig; authoritative German-language institutional source.

outlets.name: Saarland erleben! (touren.saarland)
outlets.credible: Saarland tourism tours-and-points portal (Abtei Tholey, Ristorante Roma); German-language, run alongside the state tourism authority.

outlets.name: KuLaDig — Kultur.Landschaft.Digital
outlets.credible: Scholarly cultural-landscape heritage database (LVR/partners) documenting monuments such as the Saarlouis Deutsches Tor & casemates; German-language.
